subject: general
question: What is the name of the geographic feature that serves as a boundary between Europe and Africa?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Strait of Gibraltar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Strait of Gibraltar **lies between the **southern tip of Spain (Europe) and the northern tip of Morocco (Africa)**.
 
• It **connects the Atlantic Ocean to the Mediterranean Sea** and** separates Southern Spain in Europe from Northern Morocco in Africa**.
 
• It is strategically important as it serves as the gateway between the Mediterranean Sea and the Atlantic Ocean.
 
• This strait has been a significant maritime route for centuries, facilitating **trade** and cultural exchange between Europe and Africa.
 
• It is** one of the busiest maritime routes** in the world, with both commercial ships and naval vessels passing through it regularly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/149749c2bf2426fe542db7371aafa4fb9c5eb59e39271ec4c0793a2c7e563c4a.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Bosporus Strait** connects the Black Sea to the Sea of Marmara and separates Europe from Asia in Turkey.
 
• The **Dardanelles Strait** also in Turkey, connects the Aegean Sea to the Sea of Marmara.
 
• The **Malacca Strait** is located between the Malay Peninsula and the Indonesian island of Sumatra, connecting the Pacific Ocean to the Indian Ocean.
